build.backend_new_suite: backend/tests/cover-photo-keeps-stock.test.js 8/8 (real API, real database). The moment is made by running a real order's stock movement (stock.service.moveProducts) on its own connection, leaving it open, sending the save, seeing it wait for the row in pg_stat_activity, then committing. Checks: a sale during a photo save stays sold; a cancelled order's piece during a photo save stays back; behaviour kept (photos added after the ones there, 6 at most, the first is the cover, nothing else in the record moves); the two refusals; a record stored as text; a product with no record; a sale during the older save with a stock; the older save with no stock sent.
